claim: Rapid adoption of a specialized probabilistic decision model suggests agent control loops are separating decision functions from general-purpose text generation.
verifiedFacts: Vercel reports Jev reached nearly 13% of paid AI Gateway teams within 24 hours, more than twice any prior model launch on that gateway.
Jev returns typed choices, scores and booleans with probabilities for tool selection and continue, retry, stop or review decisions.
inference: Seed Loom should compare explicit probabilistic decision surfaces with free-text evaluator decisions.
Specialized decision components may make uncertainty easier to route to human review.
significance: Inspectible production adoption of a component shape aligned with governed stop, retry and review decisions.
assumptions: Vercel paid-team telemetry is representative of its gateway customers.
knownLimitations: One-day adoption may reflect launch curiosity.
TypeSafe performance claims were not independently validated.
